title: Moving between states - income tax boundary
facts: Federal income-tax filing continues under federal rules when a person moves between states, but state income-tax residency and part-year filing obligations depend on the states involved.
A move can require part-year resident returns in one or more states and nonresident returns when income continues to arise in another state.
Changing a mailing address does not by itself determine tax domicile or residency.
Hanka should identify the old state, new state, move date and relevant income sources before giving a state-tax filing conclusion.
